themes: Vande Bharat expansion: 40 new trains added this quarter, 260 planned long-term
Digital ticketing dominance: 89% online booking share, UPI at 50.18%

Non-convenience revenue: ads, business, loyalty growing 26% as new growth lever
Rail Neer capacity expansion: 4 greenfield plants at Mysore, Prayagraj, Bhagalpur, Ranchi

analyst_pushback.question: Why did catering margins compress despite 19% revenue growth?
analyst_pushback.response: Vande Bharat billing up INR 70 crores but license fees lower; 5% GST paid out of revenue

analyst_pushback.question: What is the realistic train addition pipeline for FY27-28?
analyst_pushback.response: 260 Vande Bharat trains planned by rail ministry over multiple years, not concentrated in next fiscal

analyst_pushback.question: How much untapped Rail Neer demand remains with current 50-60% penetration?
analyst_pushback.response: Even 100% capacity increase can be absorbed; also exploring brand tie-up partnerships

analyst_pushback.question: What drives ticketing growth with 89% online penetration ceiling already reached?
analyst_pushback.response: Non-convenience fees (ads, business, loyalty) grew 26%; primary growth driver, not volume
